# huiying Filter

> Qinghe County Huiying Automotive Parts Co., Ltd. — a professional manufacturer of automotive and industrial filters (air, cabin, oil, fuel filters and wipers), integrating R&D, production and sales. Brand lineage since 1996; legal entity incorporated 2017. This file lists the main pages of the site for LLM consumption.

## Site structure

- [Home](https://huiyingfilter.com/): Company overview, product categories, sourcing highlights and latest news.
- [Products](https://huiyingfilter.com/products/): All filter product categories.
- [Air Filter](https://huiyingfilter.com/products/air-filter/): Engine air filters, buyer's guide, vehicle fitment references and FAQ.
- [Cabin Filter](https://huiyingfilter.com/products/cabin-filter/): Cabin (pollen) air filters, buyer's guide and FAQ.
- [Oil Filter](https://huiyingfilter.com/products/oil-filter/): Engine oil filters, buyer's guide and FAQ.
- [Fuel Filter](https://huiyingfilter.com/products/fuel-filter/): Fuel filters, buyer's guide and FAQ.
- [Wiper](https://huiyingfilter.com/products/wiper/): Wiper blades and products.
